en.meta_description: A real-world dynamic light field video benchmark: 45 scenes, 5×5 views, 1080p and nominal 60 fps. Explore a sample and the VCIP 2026 evaluation.
en.affiliation: School of Communication and Information Engineering, Shanghai University
en.video_alt: Scene 0042, 5 by 5 camera array or center-view video
en.video_fallback: Your browser can download the sample video.
en.video_caption: Scene 0042 · 150 standardized frames per camera · 59.94 fps. The array and center videos use the same frame sequence.
en.motion_description: See the same movement across the 5×5 camera array. Switch to the center camera for a closer view, then explore how foreground and background shift between viewpoints.
en.motion_note: Original-speed video preserves the recorded motion. Explore parallax first, then examine the temporal detail below.
en.explore_intro: Choose a scene, then change cameras while holding time fixed. Compare foreground displacement, occlusion and reflections.
en.view_instruction: Select a position in the array. Arrow keys move between cameras.
en.array_label: 5 rows by 5 columns of cameras, A1 to E5
en.view_note: Rows A–E, columns 1–5. C3 is the center view (v12). Every image shows the same frame index.
en.image_error: The image could not load. Select a camera to retry.
en.sample_details: The 5×5 video combines all 25 standardized JPEG sequences from scene 0042, in row-major order A1–E5. Each camera contributes frames 1–150 at 60000/1001 fps. The center video uses the same C3 sequence. Web exports only resize and encode these processed frames.
en.sample_timing: Viewpoint comparisons hold the frame index fixed at 91. Lightweight images appear inline; select an image to load its larger version.
en.dataset_description: RealDynLFV contains 45 dynamic sequences: 29 outdoor, 15 indoor and one mixed scene. The standardized sequences contain 9,031 temporal frames, each with 25 views.
en.dataset_challenges: Large angular displacement, occlusion and view-dependent appearance make sparse-view reconstruction challenging. The benchmark also captures geometric and photometric variation encountered with consumer cameras.
en.diversity_alt: Nine center-view examples: indoor objects, entrances, stairs, trees, a car, a bicycle, fencing, foliage and basketball.
en.diversity_caption: 15 center-view examples from the dataset. Select an image to enlarge it.
en.pipeline_title: From camera recordings to light field video
en.pipeline_alt: Processing pipeline: acoustic temporal alignment, geometric rectification, shared cropping, fixed LUT and 5×5 JPEG frame-sequence export.
steps: 25 action cameras, 80 mm nominal spacing; source recordings at 4K/60 fps.
Use the center camera's clapperboard sound as reference, estimate each camera's offset by cross-correlation, and trim to a common start at the nearest frame.
Calibration-based rectification, shared 16:9 crop, 1080p resize and a fixed D-Log M to Rec.709 LUT.
8-bit JPEG sequences with consistent view indices and frame names.
en.benchmark_title: A dataset for reconstruction and coding
en.benchmark_intro: The paper evaluates an existing sparse-view LFV coding framework on RealDynLFV, using the fixed 32/5/8 split. Four encoded corner views are used to reconstruct all 25 views. This provides a practical evaluation setting for studying LFV reconstruction and compression.
en.release_text: This page provides an interactive sample from RealDynLFV. The full dataset is planned for public release after acceptance of the journal extension.

zh.meta_description: 真实世界动态光场视频基准：45 个场景、5×5 视角、1080p、标称 60 fps。查看交互样例与 VCIP 2026 评测。
zh.affiliation: 上海大学通信与信息工程学院
zh.video_alt: 场景0042的5×5相机阵列或中心视角视频
zh.video_caption: 场景0042 · 每台相机150帧标准化图像 · 59.94 fps。阵列与中心视频使用同一组帧序列。
zh.motion_description: 在5×5相机阵列中观察同一段运动，也可切换到中心相机查看细节，再探索前景与背景随视点变化的位置关系。
zh.motion_note: 原速视频保留实拍运动。先观察大视差，再向下查看连续帧中的时间细节。
zh.explore_title: 在真实场景中观察大视差
zh.explore_intro: 先选择场景，再固定时间切换相机，观察前景位移、遮挡与反射的变化。
zh.view_alt: 球场场景 0042，第 91 帧，相机
zh.view_instruction: 点击阵列中的位置切换视角，也可使用方向键。
zh.array_label: 5 行 5 列相机，A1 至 E5
zh.view_note: 行号 A–E，列号 1–5。C3 为中心视角（v12），所有图片使用相同帧编号。
zh.image_error: 图片加载失败，请重新选择相机。
zh.sample_details: 5×5视频直接由场景0042的25路标准化JPEG序列合成，机位按A1–E5逐行排列。每台相机采用第1–150帧，帧率为60000/1001 fps；中心视频使用同一组C3序列。网页导出仅缩放与编码这些处理后的图像。
zh.sample_timing: 视角对比固定为第91帧。页面使用轻量展示图，点击图片再加载清晰版本。
zh.dataset_description: RealDynLFV 包含 45 个动态序列：29 个室外、15 个室内及 1 个室内外混合场景。标准化序列共含 9,031 个时间帧，每帧包含 25 个视角。
zh.dataset_challenges: 大视差、遮挡和随视角变化的外观为稀疏视角重建带来挑战。数据也保留了消费级多相机采集中出现的几何与光度差异。
zh.split_caption: 按序列划分，测试场景与训练场景独立。
zh.diversity_alt: 九个中心视角示例：室内物品、入口、楼梯、树木、汽车、自行车、围栏、绿植和篮球。
zh.diversity_caption: 来自数据集的 15 个中心视角示例，点击图片可放大。
zh.pipeline_title: 从相机视频到光场序列
zh.pipeline_alt: 处理流程：声学时间对齐、几何校正、共享裁剪、固定 LUT 及 5×5 JPEG 帧序列导出。
steps: 25 台运动相机，标称间距 80 mm；源视频为 4K/60 fps。
以中心相机的场记板合板声为参考，通过互相关估计各机时间偏移，并按最近帧裁剪至共同起点。
标定校正、共享 16:9 裁剪、缩放至 1080p，并应用固定 D-Log M 至 Rec.709 LUT。
生成视角索引与帧命名一致的 8 位 JPEG 序列。
zh.benchmark_title: 用于重建与编码的数据集
zh.benchmark_intro: 论文已在 RealDynLFV 上运行现有稀疏视角光场视频编码框架，采用固定的 32/5/8 划分，由四个编码角视图重建完整 25 视角，为光场视频重建与压缩研究提供实际评测场景。
zh.release_text: 本页提供 RealDynLFV 交互样例。完整数据集计划在期刊扩展稿录用后公开。
zh.school_logo: 通信与信息工程学院院徽

zh.time_note: 场景0042，中心相机C3。拖动滑块或逐帧前后浏览，保留原始帧编号；每组展示连续三帧。
